item.text: The Criminal Justice Commission reported on an investigative hearing into allegations involving Queensland’s Children’s Commissioner and an administration officer.
item.support: The subject matter of the investigative hearing concerned allegations relating to the Children’s Commissioner of Queensland

item.text: The hearing examined alleged interference in recruitment and preferential treatment, along with alleged misuse of a vehicle and office equipment.
item.support: allegations that he had improperly influenced and/or interfered with the process

item.text: The Commission reported that the investigation was essentially complete, but disciplinary determinations had not begun and further procedural steps remained.
item.support: It is important to recognise that the determinative process has not yet commenced.

item.text: The Commission kept detailed evidence in a confidential second part, considering public disclosure premature before any disciplinary hearing.
item.support: the CJC is of the opinion that such matters should, for the time being, remain confidential.

item.quote: For these reasons, pursuant to section 27(3) of the Act, the CJC is of the opinion that such matters should, for the time being, remain confidential.
